answer: FAIL — PR #17 evidence artifacts do not conform to the multispectrum-review doctrine schema.
key_claims: Doctrine round_1_independent.required_keys = [reviewer_id, round, change_id, answer, key_claims, uncertainty_areas]; sample r1 files (pr-1-F1-r1, pr-3-F5-r1, pr-5-F1-r1, pr-6-F2-r1, pr-11-F9-r1) carry NONE of {answer, key_claims, uncertainty_areas} and most omit 'round'. Only pr-6-F2-r1 included 'round'.
All sampled r1 files instead use an ad-hoc shape: {reviewer_id, change_id, facet_id, facet_name, findings, considered, null_finding_reason, rigor, summary} — a different schema than the doctrine.
Zero r1 files declare $schema, $id, or _meta envelope identifiers; no JSON-Schema URI is bound to the artifacts, so machine validation is impossible.

Synthesis files (pr-1-synthesis, pr-5-synthesis) DO declare a 'schema' field ('multispectrum-review/v2.3.0-retrospective-pr-review') and contain doctrine-required {consensus_points, consensus_shifts_from_round_1_to_round_2, unresolved_tensions, final_recommendation, termination_reason} — synthesis layer is compliant; r1 layer is not.
F5 (quality) facet finding of schema non-conformance is CONFIRMED at the r1 evidence layer: shape divergence is uniform across 74 r1 artifacts, not isolated.
Inconsistency within PR #17 itself: some r1 files include {pr_number, pr_title, merge_commit_sha}, others omit them (pr-1-F1-r1 vs pr-3-F5-r1) — schema is not even self-consistent across the wave.
uncertainty_areas: Whether a retrospective-PR-review variant schema legitimately replaces the canonical round_1_independent.required_keys; doctrine file at specs/cross-cutting/multispectrum-review.json was not resolvable at origin/dev tip (exists on disk only) so the binding version could not be reverified against the committed tree.
Whether 'summary' was intended as an aliased 'answer' and 'findings' as aliased 'key_claims' — if so, an explicit alias map in doctrine would close the drift; absent that, this is non-conformance.
remediation: Either (a) emit r1 artifacts with the doctrine-required keys {answer, key_claims, uncertainty_areas, round} and bind via $schema/$id, OR (b) ratify a retrospective-PR-review r1 variant in specs/cross-cutting/multispectrum-review.json with an explicit alias map and version-pin it (schema field), then re-emit/migrate the 74 r1 files. Add a CI lane that JSON-Schema-validates every evidence/debate/*.json against its declared $schema.
